title: Mask Adoption Behavior Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and sustain mask-wearing behavior over time under social influence, policies, information campaigns, and supply/cost constraints.

interactions.name: peer_social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask usage among their network neighbors and update attitudes and behavior based on perceived norms and social influence weights.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: PolicyAuthority mandates mask use at certain Location types and enforces compliance with varying strictness and potential fines.

interactions.name: information_campaign
interactions.description: PolicyAuthority broadcasts campaigns that shift risk perception and attitudes toward masks, modulated by individuals’ trust in authority and misinformation exposure.

interactions.name: retail_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals attempt to purchase masks from Retailers subject to stock and price; affordability and access influence ownership and subsequent use.

interactions.name: norm_visibility_at_locations
interactions.description: Mask wearing at Locations is more visible in crowded venues, reinforcing norms and affecting visitors’ immediate mask decisions.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until at least 50% of the population wears masks.

metrics.name: steady_state_adoption
metrics.description: Average mask-wearing rate over the final 20% of simulation steps.

metrics.name: compliance_in_mandated_locations
metrics.description: Share of visits to mandated locations where the visitor is masked.

metrics.name: adoption_disparity_by_income
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between top and bottom income quartiles.

metrics.name: retention_rate
metrics.description: Probability that a previously masking individual continues masking across consecutive visits/time steps.

metrics.name: masks_sold
metrics.description: Cumulative number of masks sold by retailers.

metrics.name: network_cascade_size
metrics.description: Largest connected component of adopters in the social network relative to population size.
